import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(top_breeds))
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
# Reorder by age
age_order = ['0-Jährige', '1-Jährige', '2-Jährige', '3-Jährige', '4-Jährige', 
             '5-Jährige', '6-Jährige', '7-Jährige', '8-Jährige', '9-Jährige',
             '10-Jährige', '11-Jährige', '12-Jährige', '13-Jährige', '14-Jährige',
             '15-Jährige', '16-Jährige', '17-Jährige', '18-Jährige', '19-Jährige', '20-Jährige']
age_order_present = [age for age in age_order if age in age_counts.index]
age_counts_ordered = age_counts.reindex(age_order_present)
ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts_ordered)), age_counts_ordered.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, len(age_counts_ordered), 2))
ax2.set_xticklabels([str(i) for i in range(0, len(age_counts_ordered), 2)], rotation=0)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by Zurich District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 20, i, str(int(v)), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Gender Distribution (Owner vs Dog)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
owner_gender = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
dog_gender = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()

x = range(len(owner_gender))
width = 0.35

# Filter to match categories
common_genders = list(set(owner_gender.index) & set(dog_gender.index))
owner_vals = [owner_gender.get(g, 0) for g in ['männlich', 'weiblich'] if g in owner_gender.index]
dog_vals = [dog_gender.get(g, 0) for g in ['männlich', 'weiblich'] if g in dog_gender.index]
labels = [g for g in ['männlich', 'weiblich'] if g in owner_gender.index]

x_pos = range(len(labels))
ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x_pos], owner_vals, width, label='Owner Gender', color='coral', alpha=0.8)
ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x_pos], dog_vals, width, label='Dog Gender', color='skyblue', alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Gender Distribution: Owners vs Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax4.set_xticklabels([l.capitalize() for l in labels])
ax4.legend(fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add values on bars
for i, (o, d) in enumerate(zip(owner_vals, dog_vals)):
    ax4.text(i - width/2, o + 500, str(o), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
    ax4.text(i + width/2, d + 500, str(d), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
